question: What youthful form of sixteen years results from constant yogic practice?
premises: Constant practice through yoga is the means.
A form of two-times-eight years is named.
This form becomes the practitioner's state.
inference: Through constant yogic practice, one attains the form of a sixteen-year-old.
plain_english: Through constant yogic practice, one attains the form of a sixteen-year-old.
